# Real robot descriptions

URDF as their makers publish them, read by `tests/hot/urdf.test.ts` to keep
`urdf.read` honest against robots nobody wrote for it. Fetched 2026-10-08;
each keeps its own licence.

| File | Robot | Source | Licence |
|------|-------|--------|---------|
| `franka-panda.urdf` | Franka Emika Panda arm and hand | [bulletphysics/bullet3](https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/blob/master/examples/pybullet/gym/pybullet_data/franka_panda/panda.urdf) (generated by xacro from Franka's `panda_arm_hand.urdf.xacro`) | zlib |
| `unitree-go2.urdf` | Unitree Go2 quadruped | [unitreerobotics/unitree_ros](https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_ros/blob/master/robots/go2_description/urdf/go2_description.urdf) | BSD-3-Clause |
| `turtlebot3-burger.urdf` | ROBOTIS TurtleBot3 Burger | [ROBOTIS-GIT/turtlebot3](https://github.com/ROBOTIS-GIT/turtlebot3/blob/main/turtlebot3_description/urdf/turtlebot3_burger.urdf) | Apache-2.0 |
| `crazyflie.urdf` | Bitcraze Crazyflie 2 | [IMRCLab/crazyswarm2](https://github.com/IMRCLab/crazyswarm2/blob/main/crazyflie_sim/crazyflie_sim/backend/data/pinocchio/crazyflie2.urdf) | MIT |
| `nasa-osr.urdf` | NASA JPL Open Source Rover | [nasa-jpl/osr-rover-code](https://github.com/nasa-jpl/osr-rover-code/tree/master/ROS/osr_gazebo/urdf) — `osr.urdf.xacro` expanded with xacro, `$(find osr_gazebo)` replaced by a relative path | Apache-2.0 |

TurtleBot 4's description is xacro that needs a ROS install to expand, so
the TurtleBot3 Burger stands in for a two-wheeled base.
